text.tspan: على الناس كلها: أي حد يقفل بيه،
لكن المفتاح اللي يفتحه في جيبك إنت بس.

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Like an open snap padlock you hand out
to everyone: anyone can lock with it,
but only you hold the key that opens it.

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Arial, sans-serif

text.tspan: هل يستطيع سمير أن يفتح صندوقًا

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: If Mona gives her padlock to everyone,
that Ahmed locked with it? Why?
